lines.speaker: filch
lines.sound: Filch muttering to Mrs Norris as he shuffles past, never turning
text: Nothing here, my sweet. Nothing here.
Mud all down my clean corridor. Someone'll be sorry, my sweet.
Peeves again, I'll be bound. We'll have him out one day, my sweet.
My knees, my sweet. Up and down these stairs all day, and who thanks me?

lines.sound: Filch muttering to Mrs Norris, sat staring at the broom cupboard, as he shuffles straight past
text: Come away, my sweet. It's only the cupboard.
Mops and buckets, my sweet. Nothing in there but mops and buckets.
